title: Four-Mouth Hollow Mudbrick Wind Tower
description: One original fixed mudbrick-style wind-tower architectural visual. A thick square shaft remains genuinely open underneath and continues upward into four broad upper face openings between integral corner piers. A complete projecting flat cap shades the four openings, while integral hollow base and sill collars preserve the uninterrupted inner shaft. Unlike a clock tower with a transverse arch and solid clock box, a solid lighthouse with a separately floored lantern room, or blind wall niches, this is one coherent downward-open four-mouth shaft. No old geometry is imported. Static unoccupied visual only: no airflow, cooling, ventilation, load, installation, structural safety, historic reconstruction or compatibility with another roof or building is claimed.
